en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a grand neoclassical building with two prominent towers and a façade of Corinthian columns. In the foreground, there is a paved square or street with a few pedestrians in early 20th-century clothing, and some trees and bushes in a garden area. The structure itself is richly decorated, with reliefs and statues visible on the roof and above the portico.
